name: devdigest/onion-architecture
summary: Forces Onion Architecture dependency direction in this repo's backend packages (server/, reviewer-core/): domain and application logic stay framework-free at the center, Fastify/Drizzle/HTTP/external clients stay at the rim as swappable adapters behind interfaces, and all coupling points inward. Use when adding a module, writing a service.ts/repository.ts, deciding whether a Fastify or Drizzle type may appear in business logic, wiring a new adapter into platform/container.ts, or reviewing whether a change leaks infrastructure into the domain.
